evals.name: bike-shop
evals.prompt:
References (no files, go by the description): kinetic type like Apple and Linear launch videos, glass cards, fast wipes with motion blur.

Make a promo for Harbor Cycles (harborcycles.example), a bike repair and rental shop. 30–45 seconds, you pick the exact length. Energetic, but it must stay clear what the shop offers.

Facts: same-day repairs; 40 rental bikes, e-bikes included; open 8:00–20:00 every day; a free safety check with every rental; booking online takes a minute.
evals.expected_output: A 30–45 s 16:9 promo with an original score, bike-world sounds (freewheel ticks, a bell, a chain), only the given facts on screen, the booking site as the call to action, QA passing.
assertions: A final MP4 is delivered in outputs/
Aspect ratio as asked
Duration within the asked range
Has an audio track
Integrated loudness between -16 and -11 LUFS
True peak at or below -0.5 dBTP
The soundtrack is not the template demo score (fingerprint < 0.75)
The soundtrack differs from the other briefs' soundtracks in this configuration (max < 0.75)
The call to action is in the video's source

The score uses a brand-world builder or a custom voice

evals.name: climbing-vertical
evals.prompt:
Make a vertical 9:16 video for Reels and TikTok, 20–25 seconds, for Summit Climbing (summitclimbing.example), a bouldering gym.
What we have: 120 routes reset every week, beginner classes every evening, the first visit free with a friend, shoes and chalk included, open until 23:00.
Bright and fun, so people want to try it. Upbeat music, stylish, not cheesy. Sign-up is on the site.
